# Collection API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A named subgroup of a project's sessions, for an analysis or a figure.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/collection/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `collection` (detail, create, update), `collections` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `project` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `name`, `project` unique together

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `project` | [`project`](/api/stem/project/) id **[required]** |
| `sessions` | list of [`session`](/api/stem/session/) ids **[required]** |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('collection', load_all=True)
records = resp['collections']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('collection', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.collections;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "collections": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Collection 1",
            "project": "<project-id>",
            "sessions": [
                "<session-id>"
            ],
            "description": "",
            "tags": []
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('collection', data={"name": "Collection 1", "project": "<project-id>", "sessions": ["<session-id>"]})
record = resp.json()['collection']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Collection 1', 'project', '<project-id>', 'sessions', {{'<session-id>'}}), 'collection');
record = created.collection;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('collection', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['collection']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('collection', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.collection;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "collection": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Collection 1",
        "project": "<project-id>",
        "sessions": [
            "<session-id>"
        ],
        "description": "",
        "tags": []
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('collection', id='<id>', data={"name": "Collection 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Collection 1 (renamed)'), 'collection', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collection/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('collection', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'collection');
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Collection data model page](/datamodel/stem/collection/).
